title: Angels and Worship
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Angels worship God and direct worship away from themselves to Him alone. Their worship reveals the glory of God and teaches believers that no created being should receive the honor due to the Lord.
summary: Angels worship God and direct worship away from themselves to Him alone. Their worship reveals the glory of God and teaches believers that no created being should receive the honor due to the Lord.
christFocus: Angels worship Jesus Christ because He is the eternal Son and Lamb who was slain. Their worship confirms His divine glory and calls the church to join heaven’s praise.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Holy angels are worshipers before God. They praise His holiness, obey His commands, and honor His glory. Their worship is not casual or self-centered; it is directed to the Lord alone.

Scripture also warns against worshiping angels. Even when angels appear in glory, they refuse worship and command God alone to be worshiped. Created servants must never receive the devotion due to the Creator.

Angels worship Christ. Hebrews says the angels of God worship the Son, and Revelation shows heavenly beings praising the Lamb. This reveals the divine glory of Jesus and His worthiness to receive worship.

Angelic worship helps believers see that worship is the highest response to God’s revelation. The church on earth joins the praise of heaven when it exalts the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Angel fascination can quietly become idolatry. People may speak more about angels than God or seek comfort in spiritual beings rather than the Lord who commands them.

This doctrine redirects attention to God. If holy angels refuse worship, then believers must refuse every form of devotion that shifts glory from the Creator to the creature.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Worship God alone. Let the worship of angels stir reverence, not curiosity. Honor Christ as worthy with the Father and the Spirit, and reject any teaching, practice, or experience that turns a created being into an object of devotion.
